# Original sources: pricesensitivitymeter

Repository: https://github.com/max-alletsee/pricesensitivitymeter
Commit: `8188de1e95fa0f407073677f6f88baec2f43c8d4`

Files are copied without code changes. Original license and copyright are retained.
Unmodified upstream R functions executed with pinned R 4.2.2; no R package installation, fitting, plotting or weighted survey path.

`pricesensitivitymeter` identifies its license as MIT + file LICENSE; the short LICENSE supplies year and holder. Robyn's LICENSE contains the full MIT grant.

The standard R MIT license template is reproduced verbatim in `MIT-template.txt`, retrieved from https://svn.r-project.org/R/trunk/share/licenses/MIT. The original LICENSE identifies YEAR 2019 and COPYRIGHT HOLDER Max Alletsee.
